subject: Request HAM-DFW December shipment
body:
Hi,

please quote the cheapest air freight Hamburg (HAM) to Dallas (DFW) for 2 pallets of plastic granulate samples, 300 kg, 1.2 cbm. We deliver to HAM. The cargo will be ready on 4 December 2026 and should fly that week.

All-in in EUR please.

Best regards
Tim Koch
Logistics
Hansa Kunststoff KG
